title: Symrise launches new chicken production capabilities in France, strengthening its global platform
summary: – New cooking line and spray-drying tower significantly expand chicken ingredient and taste solution production at the Berric site in France – €27.5 million investment now operational, enhancing capacity, flexibility and supply resilience – Expanded European footprint complements Symrise’s leading position in North America and strengthens its global chicken platform

extraction.key_fact: Symrise가 프랑스 공장에 새 생산 설비를 가동했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: New cooking line and spray-drying tower significantly expand chicken ingredient and taste solution production at the Berric site in France
